thread.title: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners
thread.title_full: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners

author: Roadkill Mcgee
text:
There is a lot to unload here.
1st There are states that allow 3rd party cdl testing. The truck driving school tests their students where instructor/examiner jobs are tied graduation rates. Conflict of intrest anyone?
2nd Fill in blank foreigner sets up a truck school in certain states brings his nephews brothers sisters aunts etc.. see 3rd party examiner above.
3rd Fill in blank foreigner opens a transport company who then hires all of his cousins graduates from fly by nite cdl school. He in turn runs loads below going freight rate which hurts all transport companies.
4th Fill in blank foreigner transport low skill driver has an accident "anything over $500 must be reported causing liability insurance rates to increase for all.
5th To much technology is incorporated into the new tractors. Tech is good only to a point where it begins to diminish the driving skills
6th GPS Drivers will follow a GPS strait into the gates of he'll and I quote that's where the GPS said turn. Can't read a road map you shouldn't be driving a semi.
7th PHONES! Even though the DOT increased cell phone use in a CMV up to $2,700 for the driver and $11,000 for the company it hasn't put a dent in the distracted driving.
8th The 70 hour work week getting home every 2 weeks on average for 34 hours. Sitting at a dock loading/unloading for hours for no or minimal hourly pay when you get paid and reviewed by the mile and miles driven.
9th Parking and rest areas. There arent enough of either. DOT requires an 10 hour rest break every 24 hour cycle most Drivers are on an irregular sleep cycle for most there is no 24 hour"DAY" start today at 2am end driving at12pm sleep 10 get up and go at 10pm after sleeping in a sleeping area in the truck.
10 Retention ,most companies couldn't care less if a skilled and knowledgeable driver leaves the truck their philosophy is well we will hire fill in the blank foreigner for less.
That ends today's lesson on why I want to be a trucker. Keep it between the ditches and the shiny side up!
